options.name: boot_time_command
options.description: Command to run that returns a unique string indicating the last time the system was booted. Setting this to a command that has different output each time it is run will cause the task to fail.

options.name: connect_timeout
options.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a single successful TCP connection to the WinRM endpoint before trying again.

options.name: post_reboot_delay
options.description: Seconds to wait after the reboot command was successful before attempting to validate the system rebooted successfully. This is useful if you want wait for something to settle despite your connection already working.

options.name: pre_reboot_delay
options.description: Seconds to wait before reboot. Passed as a parameter to the reboot command. The minimum version is C(2) seconds and cannot be set lower.

options.name: reboot_timeout
options.description: Maximum seconds to wait for machine to re-appear on the network and respond to a test command. This timeout is evaluated separately for both reboot verification and test command success so maximum clock time is actually twice this value.

options.name: test_command
options.description: Command to expect success for to determine the machine is ready for management. By default this test command is a custom one to detect when the Windows Logon screen is up and ready to accept credentials. Using a custom command will replace this behaviour and just run the command specified.
